text:
zoe: Heads-up 9: scheduling a rolling maintenance window in apac-west2 Tue 01:00-04:00 local. Trigger: recurring thermal probes + sporadic NIC packet drops on a small cohort of racks. Scope: 4 racks (racks 4-7). Reserved/dedicated pools will not be touched. Aim: apply NIC microcode, soft-reboot GPUs, validate thermal equilibrium and NVML counters. Well try to avoid cross-region backfill.

marc: What's the estimated capacity hit and canary plan?

zoe: Estimate ~5-8% shared capacity transiently if we run serial single-rack cohorts. Canary: rack-4 at 01:15 (4 nodes) -> observe 15m -> if green proceed one rack every 20-25m. Manual approval required before expanding beyond canary.

anil: Ops suggestions: pre-seed prefix and KV caches 30-45m before first cordon, and pause large embedding/batch jobs 00:30-05:30 to reduce memory pressure. Also set temporary request throttles for non-reserved tenants.

celine: Cost/backfill: prefer intra-region spare pool. Pulling ~12 GPUs intra-region for 3h ~ $650; cross-region (us-west) ~ $1.5k. We'll only borrow if p95 or error thresholds are breached.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: apac-west2-thermal-net-6790000001. Link: https://console.internal/maint/6790000001 (automated).

zoe: Runbook snippets for oncall (copy/paste):

```bash
# cordon nodes in rack-4
kubectl cordon node-aw2-r04{01..04} -n inference
# drain non-critical pods with ~4m grace
kubectl drain node-aw2-r04{01..04} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 -n inference
# quick nvml sample
ssh ops@node-aw2-r040 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader"
# apply nic microcode + reboot
ssh ops@node-aw2-r040 "sudo /usr/bin/apply-nic-fw && sudo reboot"
```

marc: Please include a 10-minute human approval after the canary before any expansion. We had a blind fast-roll last quarter that caused tail spikes.

anil: Network team watchlist: retransmit counters, CRC errors, and BGP stability. Rollback triggers: p95 latency +150ms, error rate +0.3% absolute, retransmit rate +200% vs baseline, or >2 failed reboots in a rack. If any of those fire revert and consider intra-region backfill.

celine: Ill draft a short customer-facing blurb for non-reserved tenants (window + expected impact + contact). Also will prepare cost dashboard and auto-alert at $800 spend.

zoe: Oncall: @anil network/watch, @marc infra-watch, @celine customer & cost. Please ACK by EOD so I can lock schedule and send comms.

anil: ACK

marc: ACK

celine: ACK :white_check_mark:
